name: Receipts
description: Generate a personal Claude Code impact report — "receipts" — from your own session transcripts, for the conversation where someone asks what all this Claude Code usage is actually buying.
longDescription: Turns your own Claude Code session transcripts into a personal impact report: sessions, prompts, files and lines touched, commits and PRs carried, split by project. `/receipts` covers the last 30 days; `week`, `quarter`, a day count or `for <repo>` change window and scope. Two files land in your home directory — a markdown summary and a self-contained HTML receipt with CSV export that prints to a clean PDF. Nothing is published anywhere.
